dct_title_s: 1930 Real Estate Plat-Book of the City of Trenton and Borough of Princeton, Mercer County, New Jersey (Street Name Index, Trenton)
dct_description_sm: The Index Page contains an alphabetical list of city of Trenton street names referenced to plate number and and Index of the City Atlas Page (C.A.P.) number to Plat-Book plate.
